statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may have contributed to the patient's previous cerebrovascular events
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason was that cardiac event monitoring is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
